topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon a piece of paper, worn and folded many times over. It was hidden away, like a secret I was not meant to uncover. The handwriting was familiar, each curve and line a reminder of the days we planned together. Now, the words seemed distant, like echoes of laughter in an empty forest. Trails we wished to hike, festivals we dreamed of attending, all etched with a promise of forever. I trace the list, feeling the weight of each unmarked item. The world outside our small sanctuary moves on, indifferent to the plans we made. It’s just this list and the silence, a contrast to the vibrant future we once mapped out under the stars.
